name: error-pages
title: Error Pages
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: Error screens on top of `empty` and `icon-stack`: `NotFound` (404), `Forbidden` (403) and `UnexpectedError`, plus the bare `ErrorPage` for other cases (maintenance, expired link). Each shows an icon, the status `code` as a small label, the title as the page's `h1`, a description and your `actions` (home, back, support). `layout="page"` fills the viewport; `layout="inline"` fills the content area of the app's layout. `UnexpectedError` puts a "Try again" button first with `onRetry` (pending while its promise runs) and, with `error`, a collapsible `ErrorDetails` with the message and stack and a button that copies them; leave `error` out where users shouldn't see it. Wiring to the router (error and not-found routes), reporting and automatic reloads stay in the app. Built-in text is in English; translate it with `i18n.labels`, or override `title` and `description`.
